# tcpshield_backend_set (Data Source)

Reads a single backend set of a network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tcpshield_backend_set" "lobby" {
  network_id = data.tcpshield_network.main.id
  id         = 123456
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric backend set id.
- `network_id` (Number) Network the backend set belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `backends` (List of String) Origin servers as `host:port`.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `load_balancing_mode` (Number) Load balancing mode, as the panel's numeric code.
- `name` (String) Backend set name.
- `proxy_protocol` (Boolean) Whether the PROXY protocol header is sent to the backends.
- `vulcan_ac_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the Vulcan anti-cheat integration is enabled.
